name: Fast GST Refund preparation APIs
description: Public preparation guidance, and creation of the Statement 3 and Annexure B JSON files for a GST export refund application. Checking records is open to everyone. A file needs a signed-in account that has paid for the claim. No source-system retrieval, eligibility decision or government submission.
